page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor built on x86_64 architecture. It features 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, providing dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, delivering an 8.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include bundled GPUs or local ephemeral storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the n2d-highmem-8 demonstrates strong single-core CPU execution alongside average multi-core performance and memory bandwidth capabilities. Synthetic memory tests record uncached read speeds of 57.86 GB/sec and uncached write speeds of 40.87 GB/sec. While general execution metrics across PassMark, Geekbench, and Redis workload tests remain within average boundaries, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and medium-scale LLM prompt processing exhibit weaker performance profiles. This instance presents a balanced hardware profile for memory-heavy compute without incurring additional resource overhead from dedicated hardware accelerators or attached local disks.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes n2d-highmem-8 effective for memory-intensive enterprise tasks such as database hosting, caching layers, and in-memory data analytics. It is also suitable for general web serving and software compilation workloads that prioritize substantial memory allocation per compute core over specialized multi-core scaling or local storage throughput.
